module.name: awsbnkctl
module.description: awsbnkctl — deploy F5 BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes on AWS EKS with secondary ENI dataplane. Runs inside the digest-pinned awsbnkctl-tools-runner container image; no host tooling required.

required.name: region
required.description: AWS region for the EKS cluster and VPC infrastructure (e.g. ap-southeast-2).

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Unique name for the EKS cluster and associated AWS resources.

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for TMM worker nodes.

optional.name: node_count
optional.description: Desired count of TMM worker nodes.
